analysis_md:
原式两边对 $x$ 求导得

$$
y\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z+y=0
$$

则

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{z+y}{y+x}
$$

同理可得：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{z+x}{y+x}
$$

也可：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_x}{F_y}=-\frac{z+y}{y+x}
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_y}{F_x}=-\frac{z+x}{y+x}
$$
